Clause 8 — When Breaker Bus-38 reported a harmonic surge, it follows that Breaker Bus-38 is placed on a standby list.

A closed geothermal seismic monitoring station applies exact telemetry rules. Use only the listed dossier records and provisions.
Closed-dossier note: an entry's status holds only when listed under Observed Statuses, derived via Decision Provisions, or reported in a verified telemetry bulletin.

Observed Statuses:
Entry 1: Sensor Node-35 is registered under active default status.
Entry 2: Sensor Node-35 belongs to Ridge Crest.
Entry 3: Sensor Node-17 holds a field beacon.
Entry 4: For Sensor Node-35, the tremor gate is released.
Entry 5: Sensor Node-53 passed geophone ping.
Entry 6: Sensor Node-78 verified battery voltage.

Baseline Rule: Sensor Node-35 is under active default status, so Sensor Node-35 is assigned to Band-Pulse unless the rules establish that Sensor Node-35 triggers borehole override.

Clause 2 — When Sensor Node-35 enters waveform triage and Sensor Node-35 holds a field beacon, it follows that Sensor Node-35 enables array priority.
Clause 3 — When Sensor Node-35 enters waveform triage and Sensor Node-35 enables array priority, it follows that Sensor Node-35 triggers borehole override.
Clause 4 — When Sensor Node-35 triggers borehole override, supersede the baseline assignment and route Sensor Node-35 to Band-Echo.
Clause 5 — When Sensor Node-35 emitted a p-wave chime and Sensor Node-35 enters waveform triage, it follows that Sensor Node-35 carries a spectrum log.
Clause 6 — When Sensor Node-35 carries a spectrum log and Sensor Node-35 carries an emergency board waiver, supersede the baseline assignment and route Sensor Node-35 to Band-Wave.
Clause 7 — If Sensor Node-53 passed geophone ping and Sensor Node-78 verified battery voltage, record a routine audit note for Sensor Node-53.
Clause 8 — When Sensor Node-17 emitted a p-wave chime, it follows that Sensor Node-17 is placed on a standby list.

Question: Based strictly on the listed dossier entries and provisions, what is the current classification of Sensor Node-35?
Options:
A. Band-Wave
B. Band-Echo

D. Band-Pulse

[Case Dossier]
A closed vintner aging cellar applies exact racking rules. Use only the listed dossier records and provisions.
Closed-dossier note: an entry's status holds only when listed under Observed Statuses, derived via Decision Provisions, or reported in a verified telemetry bulletin.

Entry 1: Cask Barrel-66 is registered under active default status.
Entry 2: Cask Barrel-66 belongs to Row Crypt.
Entry 3: Cask Barrel-66 holds a sommelier band.
Entry 4: For Cask Barrel-66, the cork seal is released.
Entry 5: Cask Barrel-13 passed hygrometer read.
Entry 6: Cask Barrel-27 verified bung alignment.

Decision Provisions:
Clause 1 — When Cask Barrel-66 triggered an ullage check, it follows that Cask Barrel-66 enters cooper inspection.
Clause 2 — When Cask Barrel-66 enters cooper inspection, it follows that Cask Barrel-66 grants vintage priority.
Clause 3 — When Cask Barrel-66 enters cooper inspection and Cask Barrel-66 grants vintage priority and Cask Barrel-66 holds a sommelier band, it follows that Cask Barrel-66 unlocks racking override.
Clause 4 — When Cask Barrel-66 unlocks racking override, supersede the baseline assignment and route Cask Barrel-66 to Rack-Beryl.
Clause 5 — When Cask Barrel-66 triggered an ullage check and Cask Barrel-66 enters cooper inspection, it follows that Cask Barrel-66 carries a stave record.
Clause 6 — When Cask Barrel-66 carries a stave record and Cask Barrel-66 carries an emergency board waiver, supersede the baseline assignment and route Cask Barrel-66 to Rack-Quartz.
Clause 7 — If Cask Barrel-13 passed hygrometer read and Cask Barrel-27 verified bung alignment, record a routine audit note for Cask Barrel-13.
Clause 8 — When Cask Barrel-49 triggered an ullage check, it follows that Cask Barrel-49 is placed on a standby list.

Baseline Rule: Cask Barrel-66 is under active default status, so Cask Barrel-66 is assigned to Rack-Topaz unless the rules establish that Cask Barrel-66 unlocks racking override.

Clause 8 — When Telescope Optic-14 logged a tracking shift, it follows that Telescope Optic-14 is placed on a standby list.

A closed high-voltage substation desk enforces exact feeder rules. Use only the listed dossier records and provisions.
Closed-dossier note: an entry's status holds only when listed under Observed Statuses, derived via Decision Provisions, or reported in a verified telemetry bulletin.

Observed Statuses:
Entry 1: Breaker Bus-24 is registered under active default status.
Entry 2: Breaker Bus-24 belongs to Wing Primary.
Entry 3: For Breaker Bus-24, the arc relay is engaged.
Entry 4: For Breaker Bus-11, the arc relay is released.
Entry 5: Breaker Bus-52 passed oil dielectric test.
Entry 6: Breaker Bus-38 logged grounding continuity.

Decision Provisions:
Clause 1 — When Breaker Bus-24 reported a harmonic surge, it follows that Breaker Bus-24 enters load balancing.
Clause 2 — When Breaker Bus-24 enters load balancing, it follows that Breaker Bus-24 opens voltage priority.
Clause 3 — When Breaker Bus-24 enters load balancing and Breaker Bus-24 opens voltage priority and the arc relay is released for Breaker Bus-24, it follows that Breaker Bus-24 activates busbar override.
Clause 4 — When Breaker Bus-24 activates busbar override, supersede the baseline assignment and route Breaker Bus-24 to Tap-Ivory.
Clause 5 — When Breaker Bus-24 reported a harmonic surge and Breaker Bus-24 enters load balancing, it follows that Breaker Bus-24 carries a transformer notice.
Clause 6 — When Breaker Bus-24 carries a transformer notice and Breaker Bus-24 carries an emergency board waiver, supersede the baseline assignment and route Breaker Bus-24 to Tap-Coral.
Clause 7 — If Breaker Bus-52 passed oil dielectric test and Breaker Bus-38 logged grounding continuity, record a routine audit note for Breaker Bus-52.
Clause 8 — When Breaker Bus-11 reported a harmonic surge, it follows that Breaker Bus-11 is placed on a standby list.

Baseline Rule: Breaker Bus-24 is under active default status, so Breaker Bus-24 is assigned to Tap-Slate unless the rules establish that Breaker Bus-24 activates busbar override.

Question: Based strictly on the listed dossier entries and provisions, what is the current classification of Breaker Bus-24?
Options:
A. Tap-Amber
B. Tap-Slate
C. Tap-Coral
D. Tap-Ivory

Clause 7 — If Sensor Node-53 passed geophone ping and Sensor Node-35 verified battery voltage, record a routine audit note for Sensor Node-53.

A closed mountain observatory operations desk applies exact telescope dome rules. Use only the listed dossier records and provisions.
Closed-dossier note: an entry's status holds only when listed under Observed Statuses, derived via Decision Provisions, or reported in a verified telemetry bulletin.

Observed Statuses:
Entry 1: Telescope Optic-68 is registered under active default status.
Entry 2: Telescope Optic-68 belongs to Bay Nadir.
Entry 3: For Telescope Optic-68, the shutter bolt is released.
Entry 4: Telescope Optic-47 passed collimation sweep.
Entry 5: Telescope Optic-14 verified dew heater check.

Baseline Rule: Telescope Optic-68 is under active default status, so Telescope Optic-68 is assigned to Dome-Orion unless the rules establish that Telescope Optic-68 authorizes dome override.

Clause 1 — When Telescope Optic-68 logged a tracking shift and the seeing index is at least 66, it follows that Telescope Optic-68 enters mirror calibration.
Clause 2 — When Telescope Optic-68 enters mirror calibration, it follows that Telescope Optic-68 clears night priority.
Clause 3 — When Telescope Optic-68 enters mirror calibration and Telescope Optic-68 clears night priority, it follows that Telescope Optic-68 authorizes dome override.
Clause 4 — When Telescope Optic-68 authorizes dome override, supersede the baseline assignment and route Telescope Optic-68 to Dome-Lyra.
Clause 5 — When Telescope Optic-68 logged a tracking shift and Telescope Optic-68 enters mirror calibration, it follows that Telescope Optic-68 holds a focus bulletin.
Clause 6 — When Telescope Optic-68 holds a focus bulletin and Telescope Optic-68 carries an emergency board waiver, supersede the baseline assignment and route Telescope Optic-68 to Dome-Vega.
Clause 7 — If Telescope Optic-47 passed collimation sweep and Telescope Optic-14 verified dew heater check, record a routine audit note for Telescope Optic-47.
Clause 8 — When Telescope Optic-29 logged a tracking shift, it follows that Telescope Optic-29 is placed on a standby list.

Question: Based strictly on the listed dossier entries and provisions, what is the current classification of Telescope Optic-68?
Options:
A. Dome-Rigel
B. Dome-Vega

Closed-dossier note: an entry's status holds only when listed under Observed Statuses, derived via Decision Provisions, or reported in a verified telemetry bulletin.

Entry 1: Sensor Node-35 is registered under active default status.
Entry 2: Sensor Node-35 belongs to Ridge Crest.
Entry 3: For Sensor Node-35, the tremor gate is released.
Entry 4: Sensor Node-78 passed geophone ping.
Entry 5: Sensor Node-53 verified battery voltage.

Based only on the listed facts and rules, what is the assigned classification for Sensor Node-35?
A) Band-Drift
B) Band-Echo
C) Band-Pulse
D) Band-Wave
